extraction_notes: Identity preserved from the supplied target: MMS8050-H-TP, manufacturer MCC Micro Commercial Components. The public datasheet is titled MMS8050 (Rev.3-1-01012019, footer MCCSEMI.COM); '-H' is the hFE(1) rank H (120-350 spec table, rank H = 200-350 per the p. 2 Classification of hFE(1) table) and '-TP' is the tape-and-reel packing code (p. 4 Ordering Information).

All scalar specs are transcribed from the p. 2 Electrical Characteristics table at TA = 25 degC; Min/Max column meanings are preserved in source_kind and no guaranteed bounds were converted to typicals.

The table gives no typical hFE, no Cobo, and no Cibo entries, so cobo and cibo are null. VBE max 1.4 V at IE = 100 mA and cutoff currents (ICBO, ICEO, IEBO 0.1 uA max) were not mapped because the schema has no fields for them.

Curve points are manual digitizations of the p. 3 typical-characteristic figures from a 200 dpi render; readings were taken at gridline positions and carry roughly 5-10% graphical reading uncertainty.
Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 y-axes are in mV and Figs. 2-5 x-axes in mA in the datasheet; all digitized points were converted to SI volts and amperes.
The rank-specific '-H' grade (hFE 200-350) applies to the 50 mA gain point; the p. 3 curves are generic MMS8050 typical data and are not rank-specific.
Maximum ratings on p. 1 (VCBO 40 V, VCEO 25 V, VEBO 5 V, IC 500 mA, PD 300 mW, Rth(j-a) 417 degC/W) corroborate the breakdown and derating figures used here.
